text:
Tess: Quick dry run at 2pm PT today for the analyst briefing w/ 3 folks from TechInsider. Want to run through the talking points + final quote polish. Embargo is 2026-04-01 08:00 PT. Can folks join? :calendar:

Darren: I'll be there. Sending the final press list now. Do we have a preferred order for the demo talking points?

Tess: Prefer: 1) latency/cost benchmarks, 2) routing/fallback story, 3) customer example + quote. Keep it tight 10–12 min + 10 min Q&A.

Alyssa: Draft quote below. Open to edits.

Alyssa: ```"Redwood Inference enables teams to ship LLM features at predictable latency and cost, without sacrificing control. Our unified runtime and routing lets customers scale confidently across hosted and private deployments."```

Sophia: Love the tone. Suggest replacing "without sacrificing control" with "while preserving control and security" — explicit for enterprise readers.

Matt: Quick benchmark note to call out: our median gen-latency at 512 tokens on Dedicated A100 is 78ms/token with 1.6x cost savings vs baseline quantized model. I'll bring one slide.

Darren: For press/analyst asks: have the fact-check packet ready (model versions, kernel optimizations, test harness). @press-bot can you attach the packet to the thread?

press-bot: Fact-check packet uploaded: https://redwood.docs/factcheck/packet_175912.pdf :white_check_mark:

Tess: Thanks. Two asks before dry run: (1) legal sign-off on quote by EOD, (2) confirm embargo timing in the press kit header. @Alyssa @Darren

Alyssa: On legal — looping in Legal now. If no issues, will sign by 5pm PT.

Darren: I moved the embargo to the top of the press kit and added an explicit line: "Embargo until 2026-04-01 08:00 PT — please do not publish before this time." Also added a short note for analysts about sensitive throughput numbers.

Sophia: For Qs that might come up: prepare a fallback statement about model fallbacks and data retention. Short draft:

Sophia: "We route requests by policy to balance latency, cost, and availability. Customers can pin model versions and opt into caching; logs and KVs are retained per customer policy." 

Tess: Perfect. Last thing — can someone run through the quote once more in the dry run? I'll assign Alyssa 3 min for the quote, then hand to Matt for the demo.

Alyssa: Sounds good. See you at 2pm. :thumbsup:

Tess: Dry run reminder pinned. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/briefing-dryrun-2pm
